name: UI-Hawk: Unleashing the Screen Stream Understanding for Mobile GUI Agents
notes: Reviewed against the EMNLP 2025 proceedings page and the full proceedings PDF; experiments were not reproduced. The PDF (10.9 MB) exceeds the receipt size limit, so the retained receipt is the landing page with its complete abstract. Per the PDF, UI-Hawk replaces TextHawk's language model with Qwen2-7B and encodes each history screenshot at a quarter of its size in 144 visual tokens; FunUI holds 2,150 Chinese and 9,347 English Android screens, and navigation is evaluated on GUI-Odyssey+ (GUIOdyssey clicks re-annotated with element boxes) and the authors' Chinese GUI-Zouwu episodes. An earlier version titled 'UI-Hawk: Unleashing the Screen Stream Understanding for GUI Agents' was posted on Preprints.org on 30 August 2024 (DOI 10.20944/preprints202408.2137.v1) by the same six authors. The paper points to github.com/IMNearth/UIHawk for code and data, which was not reviewed here.
summary: Mobile GUI agent whose history-aware visual encoder reads earlier screenshots with the current one, trained by a curriculum from grounding, referring, screen QA and summarization to navigation; adds the FunUI benchmark.
